description: a permuted view [2, 3, 2], p 0.5, training mode.
reference: torch.autograd.grad(x * (mask / (1 - p)), (x,), grad_out) in f64, rounded once to f32
notes: x is fed as a permuted view: uploaded with its dims reversed, then permuted back. Training mode with the given keep mask instead of a generated one (graph-ir.md §3.3): out = x · m and the gradient g · m, with m = mask / (1 - p). Expected values are PyTorch's (autograd) in f64 on the f32 tensors, rounded once to f32; PyTorch's own f32 result meets tolerance and gradient_tolerance (checked by the generator).
